name: मुख्यमंत्री मदत निधी (महाराष्ट्र)
description: State relief fund assisting citizens in distress, natural calamities, and medical emergencies.
benefits: Financial assistance for calamity, medical, and ex-gratia support.
eligibility: Maharashtra residents in notified distress/calamity situations.
steps: Apply through district administration / online portal.
